mapper.select: SELECT sys_program.id, sys_program.program_id, sys_program.name, sys_program.label_type, sys_program.data_type, sys_program.description, sys_program.create_by, sys_program.update_by, sys_program.create_time, sys_program.update_time, sys_program.del_flag FROM sys_program LEFT JOIN sys_role_program ON sys_program.id = sys_role_program.program_id WHERE sys_program.del_flag = '0' AND sys_role_program.role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT id, program_id, name, label_type, data_type, description, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_program WHERE id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
